description:
Fifth phase of bl-7c23. Move the compactor's output and pin the merge=ours discipline.

=== Scope ===

1. src/prompt/compactor/tools.rs: write_summary path becomes summary/<NNN>.md (zero-padded 3-digit, 1-indexed) at the worktree root. Drop .agent/compactions/.
2. src/prompt/compactor/* doc-comments and tests follow the path change.
3. Verify .gitattributes (committed by Phase 2 scaffold) on main pins goal.md, soul.md, summary/** to merge=ours. Add an integration test:
   - Scaffold a conv repo.
   - Manually create a fake subagent branch '<root>-<sub>' off main.
   - On the subagent branch, overwrite goal.md, soul.md, and write summary/001.md.
   - On main, write a different goal.md.
   - Merge --no-ff <root>-<sub> -> main.
   - Assert: main's goal.md is the parent's version (merge=ours worked); subagent's goal.md is gone from main's tree; subagent's summary/001.md is also NOT on main; subagent's steps/<sub-id>/ tree IS on main.
4. The compactor itself remains the deletion-only stub (no model call). Real compactor logic is later v0.3.x or v0.4 work.

=== Constraints ===

- The integration test in scope item 3 is the load-bearing alignment check between code and ARCH §2.6. It is not optional — without it, merge=ours can silently regress.

=== Out of scope ===

- Real LLM-driven compaction (deferred).
- Subagent dispatch (v0.4).
- Schema regen (Phase 6).

=== Gates ===

Tests, docs, alignment per AGENTS.md.
title: Phase 5: compactor migration + .gitattributes
